shots.x: The line of claimants along the shore, every one of them arranged to be chosen, every one of them leaning in.
Lakṣmī walks the line with the garland. The camera travels with her, past face after face, and she passes each one.
shots.vo: Everything in it was taken. One thing was given.

shots.x: The garland lifts toward a pair of hands that never came forward — and the cut comes before the face.
